description: This file defines a validator class for ConceptReferenceTerm objects in the OpenMRS project. It includes validation logic for properties such as code uniqueness, presence of required fields, and correctness of concept reference term mappings.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTermValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks the validity of ConceptReferenceTerm instances, ensuring required fields are present, values are unique and logical, and term mappings are valid.

methods.description: Determines if the validator supports the given class type; supports ConceptReferenceTerm or its subclasses.

methods.description: Performs validation on a ConceptReferenceTerm object, checking for required fields, duplicate codes, valid mappings, and field length constraints.
